SourceText: 轉不錯。合作箇甚麼。師云。近前來與伊道。黃
TargetText: If he does not make a wrong reply, what would it be?" The master said, "Come nearer and I will tell you."

SourceText: 舉箇無字。若不間斷好。似法燭一點便著。
TargetText: Raise the single word "No." If it does not break off, it is like a Dharma candle-once lit, it catches fire.

SourceText: 蘗遂近前。與師一掌。師拍手笑云。將謂。胡鬚
TargetText: Huangbo then stepped forward and slapped the master. The master clapped his hands and laughed, saying, "I thought the barbarian's beard was red,

SourceText: 赤更有赤鬚胡。
TargetText: but there is also a red-bearded barbarian."

SourceText: 信心銘
TargetText: Inscription on Faith in Mind

SourceText: 至道無難唯嫌揀擇但莫憎愛
TargetText: The Supreme Way is not difficult. Just disdain value-creating discrimination. Just do not be averse or attached.

SourceText: 洞然明白毫釐有差天地懸隔
TargetText: Clearly and thoroughly understooda hair’s breadth of difference. Heaven and earth are far apart

SourceText: 欲得現前莫存順逆違順相爭
TargetText: If you wish it to appear before you, do not continue to follow along or oppose. Opposing and agreeing contend with each other

SourceText: 是為心病不識玄旨徒勞念靜
TargetText: This is called the disease of the mind. Not knowing the profound meaningin vain you labor in thoughts of stillness

SourceText: 圓同太虛無欠無餘良由取捨
TargetText: Perfectly round like the great voidlacking nothing and nothing in excessindeed because of grasping and rejecting

SourceText: 所以不如莫逐有緣勿住空忍
TargetText: therefore it is not thusdo not chase conditioned existencedo not abide in empty forbearance

SourceText: 一種平懷泯然自盡止動歸止
TargetText: With a single kind of even mindnaturally all is extinguishedstopping movement and returning to stillness

SourceText: 止更彌動唯滯兩邊寧知一種
TargetText: stopping again only increases movementmerely clinging to the two sideshow could one know the single kind

SourceText: 一種不通兩處失功遣有沒有
TargetText: The single kind is not penetrated. In both places the work is lost. Dismiss being and there is no non-being.

SourceText: 從空背空多言多慮轉不相應
TargetText: Following emptiness yet turning away from emptiness. Much speech and much thought. Turn ever more out of accord

SourceText: 絕言絕慮無處不通歸根得旨
TargetText: Cut off words and cut off thoughtnowhere is there that is not penetratedreturn to the root and obtain the meaning

SourceText: 隨照失宗須臾返照勝却前空
TargetText: Following illumination, you lose the sourcein an instant turn the light backit surpasses the previous emptiness

SourceText: 前空轉變皆由妄見不用求真
TargetText: The former emptiness undergoes changeall because of deluded viewsthere is no need to seek the true

SourceText: 唯須息見二見不住慎勿追尋
TargetText: Only cease from viewslet not the two views abidetake care not to pursue them

SourceText: 纔有是非紛然失心二由一有
TargetText: As soon as there is right and wrongconfusion arises and the mind is lostthe two arise from the one

SourceText: 一亦莫守一心不生萬法無咎
TargetText: but do not cling even to the onewhen the one mind is not bornthe myriad dharmas are without fault

SourceText: 無咎無法不生不心能隨境滅
TargetText: Without fault, without dharmasnot born, not mindthe subject can follow conditions and cease

SourceText: 境逐能沈境由能境能由境能
TargetText: conditions follow the subject and sink awayconditions arise from the subject as conditionsthe subject arises from conditions as subject

SourceText: 欲知兩段元是一空一空同兩
TargetText: If you wish to know these two aspectstheir origin is a single emptinessthe one emptiness is the same as the two

SourceText: 齊含萬像不見精麁寧有偏黨
TargetText: Equally containing the myriad formswithout seeing fine or coarsehow could there be partiality or faction

SourceText: 大道體寬無易無難小見狐疑
TargetText: The Great Way is vast in essenceneither easy nor difficultwith narrow views there is doubt and suspicion

SourceText: 轉急轉遲執之失度心入邪路
TargetText: The more hurried, the more delayedgrasping it, you lose the measurethe mind enters a deviant path

SourceText: 放之自然體無去住任性合道
TargetText: Let it go and it is naturalthe essence neither goes nor abidesaccord with your nature and unite with the Way

SourceText: 逍遙絕惱繫念乖真沈惛不好
TargetText: At ease and free from vexationto fix the mind is to stray from the trueSinking into dullness is not good

SourceText: 不好勞神何用疎親欲趣一乘
TargetText: If it is not good, it wearies the spiritwhat use are estrangement and intimacyif you wish to approach the One Vehicle

SourceText: 勿惡六塵六塵不惡還同正覺
TargetText: do not hate the six sense-objectswhen the six sense-objects are not hatedthey are the same as right awakening

SourceText: 智者無為愚人自縛法無異法
TargetText: The wise are without contrivancethe foolish bind themselvesthe dharma has no different dharma

SourceText: 妄自愛著將心用心豈非大錯
TargetText: yet delusion gives rise to attachmentusing mind to seek mindis this not a great mistake

SourceText: 迷生寂亂悟無好惡一切二邊
TargetText: Delusion gives rise to quiet and disturbancein awakening there is no liking or dislikingall the two sides

SourceText: 妄自斟酌夢幻空華何勞把捉
TargetText: are foolishly weighed and measureddreams, illusions, empty flowerswhy trouble to grasp them

SourceText: 得失是非一時放却眼若不眠
TargetText: Gain and loss, right and wronglet them all go at onceif the eye does notsleep

SourceText: 諸夢自除心若不異萬法一如
TargetText: all dreams will naturally ceaseif the mind makes no distinctionsthe myriad dharmas are of one suchness

SourceText: 一如體玄兀爾忘緣萬法齊觀
TargetText: The one suchness is profound in essenceabruptly forgetting conditionsthe myriad dharmas are viewed equally

SourceText: 歸復自然泯其所以不可方比
TargetText: returning again to what is naturalobliterating the reasons whyit cannot be compared by analogy

SourceText: 止動無動動止無止兩既不成
TargetText: Stopping movement, there is no movementin movement, there is no stoppingwhen the two are not established

SourceText: 一何有爾究竟窮極不存軌則
TargetText: how could the one existultimately and to the utmostnot abiding by rules

SourceText: 啟心平等所作俱息狐疑盡淨
TargetText: Awaken the mind of equalityall activities ceasedoubt is completely purified

SourceText: 正信調直一切不留無可記憶
TargetText: Right faith is even and uprightnothing is retainedthere is nothing to remember

SourceText: 虛明自然不勞心力非思量處
TargetText: Empty and luminous, self-sowithout exerting mental efforta place beyond thought

SourceText: 識情難測真如法界無他無自
TargetText: Consciousness and feeling are hard to fathomtrue suchness is the dharma-realmwithout other and without self

SourceText: 要急相應唯言不二不二皆同
TargetText: To accord swiftlyjust speak of non-dualityin non-duality all is the same

SourceText: 無不包容十方智者皆入此宗
TargetText: There is nothing it does not embracethe wise of the ten directionsall enter this teaching

SourceText: 宗非促延無在不在
TargetText: The teaching is neither hurried nor delayedthere is no here or not-here

SourceText: 十方目前極小同大妄絕境界
TargetText: The ten directions are right before the eyesthe extremely small is the same as the greatdelusion ends and boundaries vanish

SourceText: 極大同小不見邊表有即是無
TargetText: The extremely great is the same as the smallno boundaries are seenbeing is precisely non-being

SourceText: 無即是有若不如是必不須守
TargetText: Non-being is precisely beingif it is not thusyou need not hold to it

SourceText: 一即一切一切即一但能如是
TargetText: One is allall is oneif only you can be thus

SourceText: 何慮不畢信心不二不二信心
TargetText: why worry that it will not becompletefaith and mind are not twonon-dual are faith and mind

SourceText: 言語道斷非去來今
TargetText: The path of words is cut offnotpast present or future

SourceText: 信心銘之終
TargetText: The End of the Xinxin Ming
